title: Headline Wholesale & Retail Trade
description: Overall performance of the wholesale & retail trade subsectors, covering sales value and volume.

fields.name: series
fields.title: Series Type
fields.description: [String] Series type, either absolute values ('abs'), year-on-year growth ('growth_yoy') or month-on-month growth ('growth_mom')

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as the data is at monthly frequency

fields.name: sales
fields.title: Sales Value
fields.description: [Float, RM mil] The total sum paid by customers, in RM millions

fields.name: volume
fields.title: Volume Index
fields.description: [Float] Quantity of items sold, expressed as an index with base 2015 = 100

fields.name: volume_sa
fields.title: Volume Index (sa)
fields.description: [Float] Quantity of items sold, expressed as a seasonally adjusted index with base 2015 = 100

methodology: Statistics on the wholesale and retail trade subsectors are produced using data collected through the Monthly Survey of Wholesale & Retail Trade. The data covers all establishments registered with relevant regulatory bodies which are engaged in wholesale and retail trade activities, and is reported based on the establishments' profit and loss accounts, financial statements, and other valid supporting documents. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/iowrt-technotes).
caveat: In cases where proper financial statements for an establishment are incomplete or unavailable, the data is reported based on the best available estimates.
publication: [Wholesale & Retail Trade, Jun 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/iowrt_2026-06), the latest edition of the monthly wholesale and retail trade statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on wholesale and retail trade](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/wholesale-retail-trade).
